title: Memory leak from unclosed Pillow image handlers
content:
[BUG FIX] Memory leak from unclosed Pillow image handlers
File: utils/image_processor.putils/image_processor.pyy
Root Cause: Opening images using Image.open() without enclosing in a with-statement. Pillow holds file pointers in memory, causing RAM usage to inflate under heavy load.
Fix Applied: : Refactored the resizing logic to wrap the Pillow operations inside a context manager: (with Image.open() as img:)
Tags: utils, memory-leak, pillow

title: Missing CSRF validation on POST endpoint
content:
[BUG FIX] Missing CSRF validation on POST endpoint
File: controllers/user_controller.py
Root Cause: Exposing /user/reset-password endpoint as a standard POST request without CSRF middleware validation, leaving the application open to Cross-Site Request Forgery (CSRF) attacks.
Fix Applied: Applied the @csrf_protect decorator to the endpoint and verified presence of X-CSRF-Token header.
Tags: security, csrf, auth

title: nfinite API request loop in UserCard component
content:
[BUG FIX] nfinite API request loop in UserCard component
File: frontend/components/UserCard.js
Root Cause: Failing to add a dependency array to the useEffect hook. The hook runs on every render, updates state, triggers a re-render, and runs again, flooding the server with requests.

Fix Applied:  Added [userId] dependency array to the useEffect hook, ensuring the API is only called when userId actually changes.
Tags: frontend, react, performance
